testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel the first save while closing an unsaved part: tmp/obk-capsule-scenarios-current/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:120:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel the first save while closing an unsaved part ✔ Given a new part with an unsaved sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part is in the modeling environment ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab ✔ Then a save-changes prompt identifies the part ✔ When the user chooses Yes to save changes ✔ Then a Save As dialog opens with a suggested file name ✔ When the user cancels the Save As dialog ✔ Then the part remains open and active ✔ And its sketch remains listed in the model browser
